reason: A DeepSeek Harness compatibility layer that discovers hook configurations from several agent harnesses, maps lifecycle events, and automates shell, webhook, LLM, and subagent handlers with configurable dispatch and blocking behavior.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code、Codex 和 opencode 的钩子配置适配到 DeepSeek Harness，并自动执行命令、Webhook、LLM 评估和子代理处理器。
summaries.en: Adapts Claude Code, Codex, and opencode hook configurations for DeepSeek Harness and automates command, webhook, LLM evaluation, and subagent handlers.

capabilities: discovers and reads hook configuration files
delegates work to configurable subagent commands
can block or modify tool and agent lifecycle outcomes
provides stdio and one-shot CLI interfaces
